entries.registered_question: Do singular-spectrum summaries detect known capture defects beyond direct deterministic checks?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether to retain a read-only diagnostic report.
entries.matrix_or_operator: channel-centered raw or calibration-z-scored X_window with shape 4 x 1024
entries.fit_scope: per_window_read_only; no learned threshold from held-out data
entries.baseline: variance, amplitude range, pairwise correlation, packet loss, signal-quality fields, and missing mask
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire when direct checks detect the same defects with no higher false-positive rate, or conclusions are dtype/threshold unstable.

entries.registered_question: Does the standardized M0 feature matrix show fold-stable numerical redundancy requiring a controlled representation study?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether EXP-NC-SVD-M0-001 is warranted, not M0 configuration.
entries.matrix_or_operator: training-fold standardized M0 feature matrix Z_train with approximately 52 columns
entries.baseline: per-feature variance and pairwise feature correlation report
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire when rank/conditioning adds no stable information beyond direct feature checks.

entries.method: train-only PCA or truncated-SVD M0 feature path
entries.registered_question: Does a training-only truncated feature path improve grouped M0 calibration or generalization over unchanged M0?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether a separately registered M0 sensitivity result merits further science.
entries.matrix_or_operator: training-fold standardized M0 feature matrix Z_train
entries.fit_scope: training_partition_only; transform held-out rows only with stored fold parameters
entries.baseline: unchanged M0 L2 logistic regression with C = 1.0
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire when grouped performance/calibration does not improve, rank is unstable, or matched random projection performs equivalently.

entries.registered_question: Does whitening add value beyond non-whitened train-only PCA features under identical grouped folds?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether whitening is worth retaining as a sensitivity condition.
entries.matrix_or_operator: training-fold PCA component scores with a pinned singular-value floor
entries.baseline: non-whitened PCA with identical retained-rank rule
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire when whitening worsens calibration/artifact behavior or has no advantage over non-whitened PCA.

entries.registered_question: Does a train-only PCA-plus-ICA artifact-inspection study add stable information beyond PCA and direct checks?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether a later analysis workflow merits a separate artifact study.
entries.matrix_or_operator: training-fold standardized feature or explicitly defined channel-time matrix
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire when ICA components are unstable or add no value beyond direct/PCA analysis.

entries.registered_question: Does a preregistered temporal matrix diagnostic change a defined analysis decision beyond an autoregressive or spectral baseline?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether a later temporal diagnostic experiment is justified.
entries.matrix_or_operator: per-channel Hankel H[i,j] = x[i+j] with fixed lag and reconstruction rule
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire when results are lag-sensitive, no better than simple baselines, or lack a prespecified decision target.

entries.registered_question: Does a predefined time-frequency rank summary diagnose a known artifact category beyond direct spectral checks?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether to retain a time-frequency diagnostic report.
entries.matrix_or_operator: real spectrogram matrix or complex Hermitian 4 x 4 cross-spectral density matrix
entries.baseline: band power, line-noise ratio, amplitude and protocol artifact context
negative_controls: eigh versus SVD agreement for Hermitian CSD
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire when direct spectral checks perform equally or phase/threshold handling changes conclusions.

entries.method: SVD pseudoinverse for current M0 logistic classification
entries.registered_question: Can an SVD pseudoinverse replace the current multiclass logistic M0 objective?
entries.matrix_or_operator: one-hot least-squares surrogate, not the logistic objective
entries.falsification_criterion: Already rejected because pseudoinverse least squares is not mathematically equivalent to calibrated multiclass logistic regression.

entries.method: EEGNet activation and kernel rank diagnostics
entries.registered_question: Are named EEGNet activations or filters rank-stable across held-out sessions without changing model selection?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether a representation-collapse follow-up is scientifically warranted.
entries.matrix_or_operator: fold-frozen model activations N_heldout x d and named weight tensors reshaped by a fixed rule
entries.baseline: per-layer norm/variance summaries and random-init comparison
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire when rank conclusions are session-specific, threshold-sensitive, or do not survive controls.

entries.method: EEGPT and BENDR embedding effective-rank analysis
entries.registered_question: Do pretrained representations show stable effective-rank differences from random-init and mapping controls on identical grouped folds?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether representation analysis adds a later descriptive result.
entries.matrix_or_operator: fold-scoped embedding or adapter-output matrix N_heldout x d
entries.fit_scope: fold_model_only; no global learned representation transform
entries.baseline: M2 random init, shuffled mapping, zero-fill negative control, M0 and M1 evidence
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire pretraining interpretation when control differences vanish or predictive/calibration evidence is absent.

entries.registered_question: Can a selected offline model meet a declared resource budget with low-rank factors within an output-drift tolerance?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether a later deployment review should compare compression methods.
entries.matrix_or_operator: selected linear head or adapter weight matrix
entries.baseline: uncompressed selected model, quantization, pruning, smaller architecture, and distillation
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire when it exceeds output tolerance or loses to simpler compression at equal resource budget.

entries.method: TSVD and identity-Tikhonov synthetic inverse regularization
entries.registered_question: In a known synthetic forward problem, do TSVD or Tikhonov filters improve reconstruction and stability over pseudoinverse?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether a specified synthetic inverse regularizer warrants further study.
entries.matrix_or_operator: discretized synthetic forward operator G and optional penalty L
entries.fit_scope: synthetic training/simulation selection only; unseen synthetic draws for evaluation
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire when it does not improve prespecified metrics across unseen noise/geometry conditions.

entries.registered_question: Does an explicitly justified noise covariance improve a synthetic inverse estimate over unweighted regularization?
entries.decision_it_can_change: Whether measurement-noise weighting is warranted in a future inverse study.
entries.matrix_or_operator: whitened forward system defined by a specified data-noise covariance
entries.fit_scope: synthetic problem with preregistered covariance only
entries.falsification_criterion: Retire when weight assumptions do not improve unseen synthetic performance or are not independently defensible.

entries.registered_question: Does randomized SVD provide a measured advantage for a future profiled large matrix?
entries.matrix_or_operator: future profiled matrix only; not a 4 x 1024 window or current M0 matrix
entries.falsification_criterion: Not justified unless exact SVD is a measured bottleneck and approximation meets a preregistered error bound.

entries.registered_question: Is an online adaptive decomposition needed by an authorized offline study?
entries.falsification_criterion: Rejected: no online adaptive transform or runtime state is authorized.

entries.registered_question: Does a registered nonidentity penalty operator L require a GSVD formulation?
entries.decision_it_can_change: None until a concrete paired-operator inverse problem exists.
entries.fit_scope: not applicable without an approved inverse hypothesis
entries.falsification_criterion: Rejected until a nonidentity L is necessary and improves a synthetic study.
